rows.text: You enter a dimly-lit motel on Layton. At the stairway, you meet a massive guest who looks intimidating. Its body is formed by a transparent gel-like substance, and it has two heads knocking each other — one of them has red antennae, while the other has a white halo.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You find your neighbor terrifying. It seems like you have to choose between its two personalities.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
